pool.text: In a survey of students in Year 11 Group #1, \(|A| = 18\) study French, \(|B| = 15\) study Spanish, \(|A \cap B| = 5\) study both languages, and \(4\) study neither. Find the total number of students \(|\mathcal{E}|\).
pool.sol: By inclusion-exclusion, \(|A \cup B| = 18 + 15 - 5 = 28\). Adding the \(4\) outside \(A \cup B\) gives \(|\mathcal{E}| = 32\).
hints: Compute \(|A \cup B| = |A| + |B| - |A \cap B|\) so the overlap \(5\) is not double-counted.
Add the \(4\) students who belong to \((A \cup B)'\).
Combine \(28 + 4\) to obtain \(|\mathcal{E}|\).
